question: As of November 2026, who is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc.?
answer: As of November 2026, **John R. Furner** is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc. He assumed the role on **February 1, 2026**, succeeding Doug McMillon. [[1, 2]]
